r_vp = re.compile(r'[\s~`!@#$%^&*()\-_+=\[\]{}|\\;:"\'“”‘’<>,.?/]+')
r_ck = re.compile(r'[\s~`!@#$%^&*()\-+=\[\]{}|\\;:"\'“”‘’–—<>,.?/]+')

def slug_vp(h):
    import unicodedata
    t=unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", h)
    t="".join(c for c in t if not (0x300<=ord(c)<=0x36f))
    t=re.sub(r'[\x00-\x1f]','',t)
    t=r_vp.sub('-', t)
    t=re.sub(r'-{2,}','-',t).strip('-')
    t=re.sub(r'^(\d)', r'_\1', t)
    return t.lower()

def slug_ck(h, fold=True):
    import unicodedata, html
    t=html.unescape(h)
    t=re.sub(r'\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)', r'\1', t)
    t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',t)

    if fold:
        t=unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", t)
        t="".join(c for c in t if not (0x300<=ord(c)<=0x36f))
    t=re.sub(r'[\x00-\x1f]','',t)
    t=r_ck.sub('-', t)
